messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: Boost 1.60?
parts:
Hi!

Cran has bumped boost to the bh 1.60 package. This is good news as we get an updated odeint library with builtin support to stop when excessive work is needed for an odd parameter draw, i.e. The robust integration patch will be much more elegant to Implement.

Should we upgrade soon to 1.60?

Best,
Sebastian
